race.description: Penrith Show This Weekend August 29 & 30 Pace
race.comment: SUNLIGHT STRIDE (7) turned in a much better run last time out when she scored by 4.5 metres over 1609m at Newcastle. Drawn to enjoy a nice run, with luck possibly playing a role at some point. Meets a comparable field so she is capable of taking this out. STANNUM (3) made a nice return at his latest appearance nine days ago, finishing 3 metres away in second over 1609m at Menangle. Sure to enjoy an economical run from this draw. Leading hope in a similar race. GO TESS GO (6) is heading the right way, improving last time out to finish third at this track over 2125m. Genuine threat. JOHNNY TANG (8) is worth some thought after his last-start fourth over 2125m at this track on August 20.
race.protest_reason: #3 Stannum has been declared a non-runner after being denied a fair start.
